review: I wanted to LOVE this hammock. It is handmade. It looks beautiful. But it is just so fragile. After a week of use, it already had a handful of broken threads. Within a month, the amount of broken threads makes it completely unusable. I put it on a hammock stand. We made sure we weren’t pulling it with our clothes. But it is just not built very sturdy at all. You’d really have to baby this thing to even make it last a season.
title: Very Fragile

review: I have other Keter products and they’re great. This one is terrible. I almost wonder if it’s a knock-off. First is the problem of missing parts. Even after getting TWO from Amazon, I didn’t have enough parts to make one complete deck box! The plastic is soooo flimsy. Two panels were cracked on arrival. It’s a pain to assemble and requires two people, and the side came apart anyway when I moved it. Do yourself a favor and assemble it where it needs to go unless you want to do it again. Better yet, just buy something else. This is real junk.
title: Worst Keter product ever.

review: Set up a hammock using these and it ended up breaking when my husband laid down with me - <300 lbs with the both of us. Followed the directions - metal clasp bent and released rope.
title: Broke the first time I used it

review: I am very disappointed. It’s basically a hammock with two very small pillows. Probably will last one season.
title: Disappointed

review: Looks nothing like the pic and didn’t fit our patio furniture although we checked before hand to make sure the dimensions were consistent with the product.
title: Not a good fit

review: The ropes on the fabric hammock must be too long or the fabric hammock must be too long because if you use the chain to attach the hammock to the stand the hammock hits the ground when a person lays down on it. My wife hurt her back when she tried to lay on the hammock (she was the first one) because her lower back hit the metal cross bar that is part of the stand. That cross bar is on the ground. I am going to contact Amazon and see if they can send me a new hammock (not the stand).
title: We have a problem.

review: please keep looking, there is nothing comfortable about this hammock. no one can stay on this thing and it is dangerous for kids
title: worst hammock ever

review: This hammock is barely 24 inches wide,but at 15 bux,no worth the hassle of returning...No stretch what so ever. Useless....
title: Hammock or Shawl?

review: We really like the umbrella. Easy to put up and down. Looked very well made. Color was great. After 7 days on our porch in the Adirondacks, the stitching on one of the pockets started to come apart. The support on the umbrella will not stay in the pocket. Amazon offered to refund our money but did not offer a replacement. I really wanted another of the same except with better sewing. But............money back is better than money lost
title: After 7 days on our porch, the stitching on one of the pockets started to come apart.

review: This is a disaster. What a terrible design. Its all over the place. It's goal is to pop out of your hammock. Forget asymmetrical. Forget symmetrical. Forget moving in your hammock. Now what? Tape it in? No. Put it below the hammock on top of the under quilt? Maybe i.e. not a total loss. It was described as having no stick surfaces to prevent dislodging, no chance. Imagine trying to submerge a beach ball. Fail!
title: This is a disaster

review: These were for my outdoor furniture but it was too thick and it was too big that’s the reason I had to return them
title: Shane

review: This umbrella base was a bad purchase. First off, its gigantic - almost as large as my outdoor table and I don't want this to be so huge. I didn't realize when I bought it that it was 4 parts put together by velcro and secured by a flimsy top part. I imagine I'd fill it will water and someone would rest their feet on top of it and it would soak through. I am not even going to try it because I am upset with the size. Note to self - read measurements before ordering things
title: not happy with this

review: In less than a month the hammock tore, they were great and super quick about replacing it. But less than a week later, the second one tore. My son is only 135 pounds and this is rated for up to 250 pounds. Done trying with this one.
title: they were great and super quick about replacing it

review: The stand is wobbly, comes without instructions, and missing the bag. The hammock clew has come aprt.
title: Wobbly

review: This works perfectly well watering the garden and washing the car. Keep it away from your grand son who is fond of spraying my butt when I bend over or fall asleep on the hammock. I like it, he loves it.
title: Not comfortable when you bend over and grand son sprays your butt!

review: Not impressed with this hammock / stand design at all. the base is way too small to create a comfortable place to lay. The hammock itself has a nasty odor to it. I am barely over five feet tall and this stand/ hammock is too short for me as designed. The ropes go up and Over the end of the stand and the hook can be lowered through a series of holes so that you can create enough tension so that you are not sitting on the ground on a slack hammock. Good concept except the base pipe between the two uprights is only about 3 and a half foot long.
title: Would not recommend

review: I added this to my Hammock frame and it stretched to the ground. I did not measure the stretch but my guess is about 40% which is just not realistic. It is difficult to handle because of the way it is made and it does not look to be very durable weather wise so it must be brought in out of the weather after use.
title: Unrealistic stretch

review: I like the color of this stand, it was easy to put together and so far the patio umbrella has not blown over so that's a plus! My one issue is that the bottom is not completely flat so it does wobble a little...
title: Nice color

review: Beutiful color but the pole is really thin compared to a patio umbrella I bought at wallmart for about the same price
title: Beutiful color but the pole is really thin compared to ...

review: The fit and finish could be better ...the lid seems to be slightly ajar at one end even when I try to force it close, although I will say I haven't noticed any water getting in. I can't get the hydraulic close to work (the arm seems locked or frozen in place). Good for the price though to have a deck box you can also use for seating.
title: Good for the price but the fit and finish isn't perfect

review: Decent patio set but a major pain in the you know what, to assemble. As other reviews have stated, pieces do not fit together correctly and you have to really muscle it to get things to align. Took me 3-4 hours to put together.
title: Ok for the money, expect hard times in life to assemble.

review: I purchased this for an antique patio set that I refurbished. The color was just what needed and it looks great. The reason for the 3stars is that I wish the padding was thicker for a more comfortable sit.
title: Vibrant Color!

review: **Update 7/5/20 - Great customer service!! Super comfortable hammock that I loved until it broke after 3 months. I took good care of it and didn’t leave it outside. Used it on a weekly-biweekly basis. Nice, soft fabric, it’s the perfect size for me. But the ropes are not holding up well. One broke the other day and a lot of the others are starting to fray.
title: Comfy, but broke after 3 months

review: I have a love hate relationship with Keter products. they are usually made well (have had issues with a deck box breaking). but i have consistently had products missing pieces. and GOOD LUCK trying to contact them for the missing pieces. i am still waiting a year later, for pieces to something i bought last year!
title: Missing pieces

review: Bought as an Amazon warehouse deal (only like $29!), totally worth it. So far it has held up 2 peoples weight and is very comfortable. At the price, I don't expect it to last forever, but it does seem very well made. Expect the ropes to stretch out a little bit, place the hammock higher than needed to accommodate the weight (especially 2 people). Update March 2016: Loses 2 stars as our ropes came apart in 2 spots at the wooden bar rendering it unusable.
title: Bought as an Amazon warehouse deal (only like $29! )

review: The only problem I have with this is it is shorter than expected so I had to get extra rope because it did not fit my hammock frame.
title: Very pretty but make sure you measure before ordering!!

review: The patio furniture was easy to assemble and sits well. It looks nice; however, is not very comfortable. The padding is very thin which makes it uncomfortable to sit on for long periods of time.
title: OK, not great

review: It would be wonderful on an outdoor chair but my purpose was to pad the seat of my trike to ride on the trail in comfort! it is just a bit big for that purpose but the padding is thick and wonderful!
title: It would be wonderful on an outdoor chair but my purpose was to ...

review: It was fairly easily to assemble. Getting the right height for the hammock took a couple of tries. It is much heavier than I expected. I may take it camping as long as the site is close
title: Heavier than expected

review: Its perfect for my hammock chair. However it started showing signs of rust within a couple weeks... I have moved it indoors for the colder winter months but not sure how long it will last....
title: Great, but flawed...

review: This hammock is huge, that is my 6 ft tall husband on it in the first pic. It is comfortable, and fairly easy to assemble if you have the right stand (it does not come with a stand). We have an adjustable stand that we used and it took some time to get it set right for this hammock. The other thing is that it is not heavy enough for it's size, just the wind can knock the whole thing over.
title: Need correct stand

review: The pressure washer is easy to assemble and the nozzles are easy to change. Cleaning the deck wasn't as easy. To get enough pressure to clean we had to get very close to the surface so the cleaning path was about 2" wide using the yellow nozzle. The image with the patio furniture is the before; after is the empty deck. This was also true on our sidewalk. The red nozzle would have only cleaned a width of about 3/4".
title: Does the job...but slowly

review: This only comes with the stand itself which faked me out a bit. There are similar hammock stands out there which include the cloth hammock too and everything is the same price as just this stand. I've purchased both ways and there is no difference in the quality of the stand when I've bought them bundled or separate so look I definitely will look for a purchase that includes both at a similar price point.
title: Stand only. Next time I will buy a combo for the same price.

review: This cantilever umbrella works well but not a high quality umbrella, is a value umbrella that works. I was able to quickly put it together and use it over my hammock in the back yard. At the price point it’s not something that will last a long time and it’s pretty light so you’re gonna need something to weigh it down if you have any kind of wind.
title: Good value

review: Rather easy to assemble for a petite 53-year old woman. The "attached" tray flips off easily as it is not secured, it is just set on top of the post. Perhaps it is just me and my continual body adjustments or I have the hammock at just the right height? Regardless, the stand is sturdy, adjustable, and portable - not to mention affordable. How can you go wrong?? If I could give 4 1/2 stars I would, the tray is where I took off the .5 star.
title: Easy to assemble, even for an old chick ;) Tray is a challenge...

review: Needed these to support my patio umbrella, my only problem with them was it said can use either water or sand but basically you have to use sand because the cap that comes on the bases does not hold liquid in, it just leaks right out so I did end up having to fill them with sand.
title: Pretty good 🏖

review: I live in a very windy area, so purchased this for my outdoor patio umbrella. We filled with water and it worked great to give the needed stability. Was impossible to drain out all the water when I stored it, but still a good product. Maybe needs drain hole in a better location for better drainage.
title: Worked Well

review: That is my complaint and maybe my fault for not noticing but I’ve never had a deck box that didn’t have an area to put n a lock. I’m going to use it to store left over tiles. It’s not a huge deck box but it’s big enough and I bought it during prime day so the price was right
title: Does Not Have an area to Lock

review: Assembly was a little confusing due to the 2 metal parts that need to be attached to the actual hammock & not the stand ( directions do not clarify this so you have to figure it out). Other than that it was easy to put together and was able to do it myself without help. It’s a good looking hammock, large & comfortable.
title: Very nice hammock

review: No assembly required, easy to fold, and quite comfortable. I am pleased with this versatile set. Very easy to set up and move to wear you need some extra chairs and a small table. I would not recommend these chairs for small children or elderly as they could tip sideways. I’m haven’t experienced a problem with this, but the base of the chairs are shorter. I have found this set to be very handy and practical for many situations. Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
title: Small but strong foldable patio set!

review: These are very attractive and well made albeit really small. Get a ruler so you can visualize the size. Somehow I thought they'd be bigger. Nice for a small herb garden on a patio table.

review: This fire table is the perfect size for my patio table - I just wish it came with fuel. Looks nice and creates just the right ambiance.
title: Wish it came with fuel

review: Its a nice addition to the patio table when sitting out in the evening. I didn't receive instructions with the item so had to wing it.

review: This does not work for all hammocks (ones with a cross bar) had to buy a shorter different hammock but I love being able to move it where I want it. It is very sturdy

review: I didn't see it personally as I sent it to my daughter for my grandson to go with the Hammock Chair for Indoor and Outdoor use (blue). From what the pictures that my daughter sent, works great so far with the Hammock, my grandson loves it.

review: This patio set is very good for the price. It assembles easily and solidly. The rocking chairs and side table are all sturdy and have held up well to the weather thus far.
title: Good Quality

review: Over the years, my hammock has become weathered. The wooden portion that attaches to the chain has become brittle and weathered. I was in need of a replacement so ordered this one. It is perfect. So, this one doesn’t look like my old one, I plan to take it off the stand during the winter and store in our storage room. The hammock color is cream, which should keep me cool. The fabric or cloth is durable and thick. This hammock will hold up to 440lbs (2 adults). It is perfect for reading a good novel, napping, or simply relaxing. I plan to get a lot of use out of it.
title: Let the relaxation begin.

review: nice umbrella but I wish the pole was a little longer. Very nice option for a patio table on a small deck as well as the beach.
title: nice looking

review: We really like ours. The quality seems great and we can fit two people or one person and two dogs on this thing. It is quite big. We had to expand our hammock stand by a foot and a half.
title: Pleased with it.

review: I’m sorry I don’t have a pic. I cannot tell you how beautiful this set is. Dropped them off at my rental cottage in Mi. You will not be disappointed. Great buy and such a lovely and beautiful robins egg blue joyous color.
title: You will not be disappointed- gorgeous patio set

review: My husband and I enjoy sitting out on the deck during the early evenings. When the sun sets, it hits us right in the eyes. Our old umbrella was in need of replacing, so this one was ordered. I love the chestnut color. It's natural looking. The fabric has a woven type look that does allow a little bit of light through, but it does block the super bright sunlight. It fit into our patio table as expected. It didn't take very long to set it up. The crank and tilt features work nicely. Overall, we are very pleased with this.
title: Excellent Umbrella!

review: Love this hammock. Super sturdy, easy to put together and great quality. I love it comes with a bag too so you can easily take it apart and store when not in use.
title: Perfect deck accessory!

review: Great hammock. Pretty easy to setup and seems durable. It’s s great value for the price. Very comfortable and relaxing.
title: Nice

review: For the price this is a good deal. It is easy to setup and comfortable to lay in. We had to adjust the hammock height after a few uses because the fabric stretches out a bit as you use it. Holds our whole family of 5. Kids enjoy it too.
title: Good value

review: Works great. I like this little temp and humidity gauge, and It does not Take up allot of space. I put this out on my patio table between two outdoor couches under the wood awning. After two days it adjust to the weather, and Is giving us the same weather as my iPhone says, perfect. I live in California where there is not high humidity, is also giving A perfect reading. Even though this is small it’s easy to read. Light weight, and has a stand. Received this in black and I like the way it looks.
title: Perfect readings. No complaints.

review: This is my 6th Classic Accessories for our BBQ's, outdoor tables, and chairs. There well made, and have kept everything dry in Rain and Snow for a couple of years now. My outdoor table does not have an Umbrella hole in the middle. There is a flap for the Umbrella hole, which looks like it would keep the water out, but I used a heavy silver tape over it, and there is not any water leaking through. We had rain and snow last night, (California) and everything is dry. Very happy with all my Classic Accessories.
title: Well made, keeps rain and snow out.

review: Well constructed metal furniture, once you get it together. It looks great, it's sturdy and comfortable. All you could want in a patio set.

review: This patio furniture is impressive!!! It was remarkably easy to put together, and it looks awesome! It's very lightweight but incredibly durable.
title: Impressive!!!

review: Bought this hammock for a gift for an avid fisherman, he couldn't wait to build and try it out! Lol It was surprisingly pretty easy to assemble and it comes with a carrying case so you can easily take it with you and set it up at your camp. It was strong enough to hold an adult male and 2 kids with ease, feels very supportive. Overall, he was very happy with the gift and can't wait for summer to take it on his next adventure! 🏕

review: Awesome hammock! It's pretty easy to set up and I love that I can move it around instead of staying in one spot. It's big, comfortable, very sturdy and it's not to heavy. Now I have a comfortable place to chill while my kids are outside playing.

review: Holds my new hammock chair with my 6’3” 230lb husband in it!! Easy to install and priced right 👍🏼
title: STRONG!

review: I love these tables! They are bright and colorful, also sturdy. They look great next to our patio chairs! I can’t speak to ease of assembly as my grandson put them together, but he made no complaints and I am delighted!
title: Wonderful patio tables

review: I got this box to keep kindling and small logs on my deck next to the fireplace and it's perfect for that. I put it together immediately after it arrived. It was fast and easy without a hiccup. What a great buy it was!

review: This patio chair is very easy to assemble and it’s very comfortable to sit. The price is reasonable considering the great quality. And this is good for indoor use too! The whole design is fashionable and breathable

Its definitely more comfortable than the old straight patio chairs we had before. One small note....the seat is narrow, so a large person may not fit or be comfortable in it.
title: Comfortable and a very nice addition to the cabin porch for morning coffee

review: The table is larger than most other bistro type patio sets. Can actually fit cups and plates etc. I assembled by myself easily. Seems sturdy and definitely beautiful. Very happy with this patio set.

review: This set is great quality and will last a long time! It arrived fully assembled in a large box, and everything inside was wrapped very well for transit (including the glass for the table). It’s very sturdy and well built. The only thing I am not sure about is that there are suction cups to secure the glass to the table; I may find an alternative way to secure it so the glass doesn’t slide off in bad weather. Overall a great buy and I’m very pleased with it!

review: This hammock is so comfortable! It's also really secure and looks great too. Assembling the stand only took a couple of minutes and it is very light and easy to lift as well! The fabric is of good quality and the colors are bright and stand out. Overall, it is a very easy and comfortable product, highly recommend purchasing it!

review: This Adirondack chair can handle all the various temperatures and weather. I had this out all summer and now winter and it still looks new. Yes, it is easy to fold and I can put it away. But, I like it out all the time and it holds up well under all conditions. Highly Recommend!!! Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

review: I’m very pleased with how this table looks and operates. It was packaged well to prevent damage and the instructions were clear and easy. The whole burner section was already assembled. review: These are plush. These haven’t faded and they have some water resistance. They look super nice and have a quality feel to them. I’m sure they would fit a variety of chairs and they have the tie strings in the back. Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
title: Fits Adirondack Rocking Chairs Too…

review: This frame is strong and stable. It was easy to assemble. We didn’t even need to raise the height, but you can if you want. review: Super Nice hammock chair frame. Fits a variety of chairs and it does give room to swing and turn. No tools required to assemble. It sits secure even if the ground might be slightly uneven. The base has rubber feet to protect decks and porches. I really like this and it worked great this summer for our chairs! Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

review: Wow, this hammock is extra wide and it swings. No tools need to assemble or disassemble the frame. How great is that!!! And it is sturdy. And it is extra wide. review: So easy to put together. Thick steel tubes that can hold 550lbs. Nice thick exterior coating on tubes. This is very comfortable. The hammock cloth is durable and strong. These frames are so strong and they fit in the nice storing bag for winter. Now every summer I can put this to food use. Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

review: Easy to assemble deck box! Very sturdy once put together and works great! We absolutely love this storage bench!! Holding up very well and we're very happy we got it.

review: We bought the hammock stand to go with out already existing canvas hammocks-worked beautifully! Very sturdy and easy to assemble and disassemble for transport. Fits in the nylon bag it came with.

review: This hammock was fine. It worked as it was supposed to. It wasn't too hard to use. I like that it is long and has a heavy capacity. It looked fine.
